text.ja: 2準位模型のBO/CP型連成と短い核熱浴 H(Q)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}I+\begin{pmatrix}-\Delta&gQ\\gQ&\Delta\end{pmatrix},\quad\psi=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)^T;\quad E(Q,\theta)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}-\Delta\cos(2\theta)+gQ\sin(2\theta),\quad E_-(Q)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}-\sqrt{\Delta^2+g^2Q^2};\quad M\ddot Q=-kQ-g\sin(2\theta),\quad\mu\ddot\theta=-2\Delta\sin(2\theta)-2gQ\cos(2\theta);\quad V^+=aV^-+\sqrt{(T/M)(1-a^2)}\,\xi,\quad a=e^{-\gamma h},\quad Q_{\rm bath}=\sum\Delta K_{\rm nuclear} 無次元の核座標と規格化した1電子角。3固定刻み、2架空質量、1固定seedのOU熱浴です。 自作模型の無次元単位。Q,時間,電子角,温度を固定し、M=20、架空角質量μ=.04/.01。cp.xのemass規約とは別です。
text.en: A two-state BO / CP-type model with a short nuclear thermostat coupling H(Q)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}I+\begin{pmatrix}-\Delta&gQ\\gQ&\Delta\end{pmatrix},\quad\psi=(\cos\theta,\sin\theta)^T;\quad E(Q,\theta)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}-\Delta\cos(2\theta)+gQ\sin(2\theta),\quad E_-(Q)=\frac{kQ^2}{2}-\sqrt{\Delta^2+g^2Q^2};\quad M\ddot Q=-kQ-g\sin(2\theta),\quad\mu\ddot\theta=-2\Delta\sin(2\theta)-2gQ\cos(2\theta);\quad V^+=aV^-+\sqrt{(T/M)(1-a^2)}\,\xi,\quad a=e^{-\gamma h},\quad Q_{\rm bath}=\sum\Delta K_{\rm nuclear} Actual coupled normalized electronic angle and nuclear coordinate, short NVE plus one nuclear OU trajectory. No first-principles/long NVE/canonical sampling/production CPMD. BO and mu.04 state comparisons use fixed4096/8192 RK4 companions; mu.01 receives energy checks only. Authored dimensionless model units with M=20 and angular fictitious mass mu=.04/.01; these are not cp.x emass units.
